glosses: to activate
книжн. вызывать (вызвать) в ком-либо, чем-либо активность, делать (сделать) более деятельным, более активным

examples.text: Работает весь комплекс, активизируя мозг, который и подает подсознательные команды.

glosses: To encourage development or induce increased activity; to stimulate.

examples.text: activate the economy

glosses: To put a device, mechanism (alarm etc.) or system into action or motion; to trigger, to actuate, to set off, to enable.

examples.text: The pranksters activated the fire alarm by spraying deodorant next to it.

glosses: To render more reactive; excite.
To render a molecule reactive, active, or effective in performing its function.
To render a substance radioactive.
To hasten a chemical reaction, especially by heating.
To remove the limitations of demoware by providing a license; to unlock.
To aerate in order to aid decomposition of organic matter.
To organize or create a military unit or station.

examples.text: A new squadron was activated.

glosses: To bring a player back after an injury.
Hacer activo. Poner en funcionamiento.
